class.name: g1_controllers/G1FreezeController
class.description: Captures each claimed joint's position on activation and holds it there under impedance control. The safe resting state for a robot whose balance policy is not running. Adapted from NVIDIA's isaac_ros_deploy_ros2_control FreezeController.

class.name: g1_controllers/G1AgileController
class.description: Runs NVIDIA's AGILE velocity policy on the 12 leg joints plus waist roll and pitch, tracking a cmd_vel command. Leaves the arms and waist yaw unclaimed so a trajectory controller can own them at the same time. Adapted from NVIDIA's isaac_ros_deploy_ros2_control InferenceController.

class.name: g1_controllers/G1SafetyController
class.description: Chainable stage between a policy and the lowcmd component. Ramps the policy in from the pose held at activation, clamps how fast each joint may move, and freezes onto the last safe pose if joint velocities leave the trained range. Adapted from NVIDIA's isaac_ros_deploy_ros2_control SafetyController.
